headline: Multiple value-enhancing opportunities in place

highlights: With the sales of gRevlimid now out of the base, the company has sizeable launches in US (carfilzomib, trabectedin and ibrutinib), Canada and Brazil to drive strong growth in exports ahead.
Sequential jump led by exports, cost curbs boost margins Natco’s Q2FY27 revenue declined 29% YoY (+31.6% QoQ) to INR 9.7bn.
EBITDA declined 55.5% YoY (+38.3% QoQ) to INR 2.6bn, while margins contracted 1,583bps YoY (+129bps QoQ) to 26.7%.
PAT declined 60.9% YoY (-1.9% QoQ) to INR 2bn, including share of profits from associates (net of tax) of INR 292mn pertaining to the Adcock acquisition.

The stock currently trades at valuations of 19.1x FY27E and 15.8x FY28E earnings, and EV/EBITDA multiples of 11.4x FY27E and 9.1x FY28E.
